Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a pilot program for renewal of drivers' licenses by subagents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle licensing subagents; adding a newsection to chapter 46.01 RCW; creating a new section; providing aneffective date; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A pilot program is created to study the viability andefficiency of authorizing vehicle licensing subagents to issue renewalsfor drivers' licenses. The department of licensing, in conjunctionwith the title and registration advisory committee, shall administerthe pilot program. The pilot program may not exceed a twoyear periodand may consist of no fewer than six and no more than eight subagentsfrom across the state. (2) To the extent specific funds are appropriated for the pilotprogram in this section, the department of licensing, in conjunctionwith the title and registration advisory committee, must develop acompetitive selection process to authorize the subagents to participatein the program. To the extent possible, the department of licensingand the title and registration advisory committee must ensure that the p. 1 SB 5455subagents selected represent different regions of the state in order toprovide an adequate measure of the effectiveness of this program tobetter serve the citizens of the state. (3) The department of licensing must adopt the necessary rules andprocedures to implement the pilot program. (4) The subagents selected to participate in the pilot program maycollect a service fee in the amount provided in RCW 46.01.140(5)(b) forissuing a driver's license renewal. (5) In addition to any other fees required by law, persons renewingtheir driver's license at a subagent participating in the pilot programshall pay a onedollar fee. The fee must be collected and remitted tothe state treasurer for deposit into the department of licensingservices account. (6) The title and registration advisory committee shall present afinal report of the findings of the pilot program to the legislativetransportation committee by March 30, 2006. (7) This section expires December 31, 2006.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2003, in the omnibus transportation budget, this act is nulland void.
